+    # ``@tool_boundary`` goes under ``@mcp.tool`` on every tool: an exception
+    # that is not a ``ToolError`` becomes one logged server fault instead of
+    # reaching FastMCP's own handler.  Raise ``ToolError(msg,
+    # log_level=logging.INFO)`` for an outcome the model can act on; the
+    # ``designing-tool-outcomes`` skill classifies each case, and
+    # ``tests/test_tool_outcomes.py`` fails a tool registered without it.
     @mcp.tool(annotations={"title": "Ping", "read_only_hint": True})
+    @tool_boundary
     async def ping(service: Service = Depends(get_service)) -> str:
         """Check that the service is alive; returns "pong"."""
         return await service.ping()
